title: CoverUp: Effective High Coverage Test Generation for Python
datasets: CM: 35 open-source Python projects and 425 modules (about 100k LOC), derived from projects previously used in BugsInPy and Pynguin evaluation; not the BugsInPy bug-version benchmark.
PY: 84 Python modules from CodaMosa exclusions; MT: 163 HumanEval functions for MuTAP comparison.
task: LLM-based Python regression test generation guided by line/branch coverage, source context and execution feedback. Objective is coverage improvement on supplied/current source, not bug-specific reproduction or causal diagnosis.
input_setting: Coverage report + uncovered function/class segment and imports; LLM may request additional code definitions, tests execute in isolation and are accepted if passing and increase coverage; otherwise iterative repair/follow-up.
author_relationship_evidence: Paper Data Availability explicitly links code and replication package; evaluation README identifies itself as the FSE’25 artifact and names the paper/authors/DOI. Both GitHub API repositories list Apache-2.0 and were pinned to inspected commits.
source_commit_or_archive: plasma-umass/coverup commit d9ca25b9282621d2779560f2be397ab0683a6733 (68-entry tree); plasma-umass/coverup-eval commit f3173196b90181974b0b684600ffde42ac36672c (recursive tree has 54,279 entries, API marks truncated=True); companion pytest-cleanslate commit 2049c8adb59da0736d9405ba0ee7b7061dc9fd57.
license: Apache-2.0 for CoverUp and replication package (also pytest-cleanslate). Third-party submodules retain their own licenses.
exact_models: Paper main run: OpenAI gpt-4o-2024-05-13, temperature 0; CoverUp GPT-4o evaluation config pins same dated model.
CodaMosa Codex baseline reuses authors’ historical cached outputs; adapted GPT-4o baseline used the same dated model.
weights_status: No model weights/fine-tuning; model is hosted API. Source supports LiteLLM/model configuration, enabling alternative LLMs but such outputs do not reproduce the paper’s exact scores.
evaluation_route: Full paper (11,328 words) read. Evaluation package README contains datasets, benchmark-specific Docker setup, scripts to run CoverUp/CodaMosa/MuTAP, compare coverage, cost, runs and continued-dialogue data; archived code/tests/logs/results are present. Pin config gpt4o-v2.sh uses gpt-4o-2024-05-13, max attempts 3, prompt-family gpt-v2, isolate tests, repeat-tests 5. Static inspected eval_coverup.py, requirements, CoverUp llm.py/config and README. Paper reports $399 for CoverUp’s CM run (4h, 58M prompt tokens) and README warns full reproduction is in order of thousands of dollars; no model/API/code execution.
blockers: The model is a paid hosted GPT-4o API; paper model exactness is pinned, but current availability/cost must be checked before a full replay. The artifact warns full replication costs thousands of dollars.
Source datasets cover projects associated with prior BugsInPy evaluation but not actual BugsInPy historical buggy/fixed instances; no Defects4J or SWT-Bench bug-reproduction study.
Evaluation is regression coverage, not oracle correctness or fault-revealing strength; coverage gains cannot establish assertions match intended behavior.
Huge evaluation tree and Docker/dependency installation burden; generated outputs/cached results are available for offline analysis.
concept_fit: Medium for process concepts (coverage gaps, source context and execution feedback as guidance), but no explicit root-cause/semantic concept representation. Tests are generated against current code and selected by coverage increase.
recommendation: Use as a strong public Python test-generation/control baseline if evaluating coverage-guided prompting or model transfer with a custom model. Do not count CM as BugsInPy bug-level evaluation: it inherits project subjects, not historical bug versions. Not a suitable primary paper for root-cause analysis, SWT issue reproduction or functional-bug oracles.
supporting_locations: Paper §§1–7, especially §4.1; extracted full text SHA-256 a8b150b5406c4d5356679fc74cd443a0dc9e7b33d5cb038752342cb64201d43b.

Pinned replication README documents test data, Docker routes, outputs, runs, metrics, and high API cost. Config gpt4o-v2 pins model; relevant source and evaluation excerpt hashes in public_evidence/source-audit.json.
GitHub API tree metadata: CoverUp 68 entries; evaluation repository 54,279 entries (recursive response truncated); archived results and test-generation logs are present.
